release_reason: Requirements 83-88 add a new capability-aware AI-native product assurance layer and corresponding machine-readable enforcement/evidence contracts.
required_before_release: PR containing Requirements 83-88 is merged from an exact reviewed head.
Source continuous certification runs and passes on the release candidate.
Specialized schemas and assurance-state validation pass.
New conformance scenarios are present and applicable static/unit enforcement is tested.
Child bootstrap initializes the new assurance and research state safely.
Commercial/runtime protocol identity references are updated consistently in the dedicated release migration.
Deterministic vendor exports and handoff verification pass after version migration.
release_rule: Do not change config/protocol/version.json, source instance version, commercial runtime protocol identity, or migrations.current_protocol_version until the dedicated 1.4.0 release migration is executed and certified.
